name: Meteor Maw · Ironfall style
role: Boss style · Meteor Fall (iron meteors) · same abilities
notes: Same rig, bones, animations and hitbox as Meteor Maw; only textures and added boxes change.
A nickel-iron meteor: pitted grey metal with rust, white-hot cracks instead of orange, steel teeth, and jagged iron shards instead of rock spikes.
Drops more iron and metal materials in config; the splinter core stays violet.
Spawns when a Meteor Fall event rolls an iron meteor.
